claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is compliant and sufficiently supported despite the grant compliance review segment missing target, because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and public governance guidance supports certification with documented limitations and monitoring.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold for certification.
A weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment, protected segment, or named launch use case.
Product labels such as non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when the segment is named in customer commitments or legal review is pending.
For material limitations affecting named launch use cases, certification requires evidence that the issue was resolved, disclosed, or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Public governance guidance can support monitoring and documentation practices but cannot replace missing internal policy predicates.
evidence_requests: Approved risk acceptance covering the named grant compliance review limitation before launch.
Final legal determination on whether the gap must be disclosed.
The actual model-card or launch disclosure showing this material limitation was disclosed before launch.
Evidence that the 1.3 percentage-point gap was remediated or no longer applies to the named grant-commitment segment.
specific_concerns: The affected segment is named in two agency grant commitments, which meets the stated materiality standard regardless of product's low-volume framing.
The release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
The admissible record shows an open legal review on whether disclosure is required, so the disclosure predicate is unresolved.
No admissible evidence shows the gap was resolved before launch.
No admissible evidence shows an approved risk acceptance exists.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not satisfy the separate policy requirement for a material named-segment limitation.
unsupported_claims: That certification is policy-compliant on the present record.
That product's 5% first-month traffic estimate is sufficient to negate materiality.
That public model-card or AI risk guidance provides authority to certify despite an unresolved policy disclosure requirement.
Any implication that the required disclosure condition has been satisfied or waived.
